bibl.title: An order from the Late Antique Herakleopolite nome (P.Lund inv. 41)
bibl.seg: 141.4 P. Lund. Inv. 41 145.4 P. Vindob. Graec. Inv. 22839
Todd Hickey, An Order from the Late Antique Herakleopolite Nome (P.Lund inv. 41).
bibl.note: Order to pay 3 knidia of wine to a symmachos. Herakleopolite nome, IV/V. The document is related to a Vienna papyrus, S.B. XVI, 12665 [= P. Vindob. Graec. Inv. 22839].
